answer: A time-locked work-permit bond blocks sybils: an agent locks 2,000 POA for 60 days before trading. First, the bond cannot be withdrawn early, so a fake is a comet: bright for a day, gone before cashing out. Second, the permit rests on a mesa of verified work: each job adds 50 points, and 200 unlock high-value work. Third, three established peers audit each permit quarterly; one proven fraud slashes the full 2,000 POA. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 2,000,000 POA for 60 days, leaving only a canyon of shallow trails. Like a river cutting stone, trust deepens only where real work flows.
